svg.title: Systems matrix - tech stack
svg.desc: Tech stack grouped into holographic modules. Core (starred): Python, C#/.NET, JavaScript, FastAPI, Flask/Flask-RESTX, .NET Web API, React, Angular/AngularJS, AWS, PyTest. Also TypeScript, Swift, Java, Bash, SQL, Node/Express, Django, Vue, Redux, SwiftUI, AWS Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, EventBridge, S3, Glue/Spark, EKS/ECS, Azure, Heroku, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, MS SQL Server, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Redshift, Tableau, pandas/NumPy, Playwright BDD, Vitest/RTL, XCTest, TDD, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, CloudWatch, Azure App Insights, Claude Code, MCP, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, Ollama, ChromaDB, local RAG, Tesseract OCR.

g.text: AI-driven dev loop: agents wired to codebases, tools and data via MCP
